treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the Government of the State of Qatar for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (2009, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: Article 29 ... The Agreement shall enter into force on the date of the last notification. 2. This Agreement shall have effect: (a) in respect of taxes withheld at source, to income derived on or after 1st of January of the calendar year following the year in which the Agreement enters into force
source_title: LU–QA Agreement 2009 – MLI synthesised text (Luxembourg ACD, 18/02/2021)

rates.quote: (a) zero per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
(c) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in the first mentioned State. The tax so charged shall not exceed (5) five percent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: The following paragraph 1 of Article 7 of the MLI applies and supersedes the provisions of this Agreement ... (WHT: events on or after 1 January 2021 in both States)

notes: Individual-only dividend tier not modelled: Art. 10(2)(b) 5% if the beneficial owner is an individual holding directly at least 10% of the capital and resident of the other State for 48 months immediately preceding the year of payment. EIF 2010-04-09 from treaty-map dataset; effect from 1 Jan 2011 (LU list: 'à partir du 1.1.2011'). Interest exemption has no beneficial-owner wording.
